description: Binary plist whose root dictionary maps the key URL to a reference back to the dictionary
notes: Hand-built. Object references in a bplist are indices into an attacker-controlled offset table and nothing stops one pointing at its own container. The value of URL resolves to the root dict again, forever. Expected: an error and no hang - ErrorKind::Unsupported, because a container where a string belongs is a type failure before it is a depth failure.
